The weekly refresh on GitHub now records to its own ledger (artifacts/ci/ledger.json). Its first transfers, recorded here before the split, are copied there and taken out of this total; the entries themselves are left as written.

Tool and package downloads (npm packages for the dependency upgrade, the pip-audit tool, multidict 6.9.1) are recorded in this ledger with size and reason, as the v1.2 brief asks, but they are not data-source transfers and are taken out of the data budget's total. The entries themselves are left as written.
